scope: Consolidated the available validation evidence for ARQ-01 through ARQ-13 and recorded the local gates observed on the current refactor state.

historicalEvidence.summary: The ARQ-01 baseline and ARQ-02..13 validation artifacts document the progressive boundary, contract, composition, projection, study and processing refactors. Historical integration results are preserved as historical evidence and are not reclassified as current ARQ-14 results.

integration.postgresql: not validated for ARQ-14: disposable environment unavailable
integration.rabbitmq: not validated for ARQ-14: disposable environment unavailable
integration.result: No current ARQ-14 claim is made for PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ integration, rollback, redelivery, concurrency or rebuild. Historical integration evidence remains in validation-arq03.json, validation-arq05.json, validation-arq08.json, validation-arq09.json, validation-arq10.json and validation-arq11.json.

limitations: Current integration and benchmark/reconciliation evidence was not produced by this report.
